title.rendered: Tottenham Hotspur Kit 25 – 2026 Dream League Soccer 2026

content.rendered:
Import or Copy URL of Tottenham Hotspur Kit 2025 – 2026 for Dream League Soccer 2026 (DLS) game for Android, which changes the overall appearance of your team, this kit can also be imported into any latest FTS – First Touch Soccer game for Android.

When building your team, You will need jersey’s, that is why you are getting Tottenham Hotspur DLS kit for season 2025/2026 and Logo below, to fully customize the appearance of your players.

Tottenham Home Kit 25/26

Copy Home Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/8STHjB1.png

Tottenham Hotspur Away Kit

Copy Away Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/3hTEZP6.png

Tottenham Goal Keeper Home Kit

Copy Goal Keeper Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/7Zrdssd.png

Tottenham Goal Keeper Away Kit

Copy Kit URL:  https://i.imgur.com/OBqJqdK.png
